evidence.quote:
A rollback
we have not rehearsed is a rollback we do not actually have.

observations.why: Operational rule set as settled and load-bearing: cadence fixed ('monthly from now on') plus a constitutive definition that ratifies the practice as non-negotiable — decision-grade performed declarative.
Flat unhedged restatement of the cadence as fact — asserted and ready to defend, but a summary record rather than a performed settling; claim, not decision.
Plain attribution of ownership, asserted without hedging — a factual claim, not a performed ratification or operational rule.

mints.name: UnrehearsedCapabilityDontHave
mints.title: a thing we have not rehearsed is a thing we do not actually have
mints.frame: Is conviction here carried by defining a practice as constitutive — equating unrehearsed with non-existent — rather than by arguing for it?
